name: College Partners
lines: Online colleges that partner with the City School. Pick a course to go to the college's own page: you apply, enrol and pay there, with the college, and the college awards the credit. Your referral code shows the college you came from SomnuMatrix. Under 18? Ask a parent or guardian first.
No partner colleges are taking students just now. They appear here as they join.
Sign in to go to a course, so the college and your City School record know it is you.
The City School is a standards-aligned, openly licensed K-12 curriculum. College courses, admission, fees and credit are the partner college's own.
